findings.evidence: Cocycle.lean:90 `theorem mem_span_of_map_eq_one` with conclusion `D w ∈ Submodule.span (MonoidAlgebra (ZMod p) G) (Set.range fun ρ : s ↦ D ρ)`, declared under `namespace TauCeti` (line 23) with no inner namespace; grep of `mem_span_` names in TauCeti shows all others carry a subject token.
findings.fix: Put the declaration in `namespace freeProP` and name it after the span, e.g. `TauCeti.freeProP.mem_span_range_cocycle_of_map_eq_one`.
findings.issue: `TauCeti.mem_span_of_map_eq_one` is a bare root-namespace name that identifies neither the span (the `𝔽_p[G]`-span of the cocycle values `D ρ`) nor the cocycle nor the free pro-`p` setting; as written it reads as a general-purpose span lemma. Every other `mem_span_*` in the repo names its generators (`mem_span_range_typeDSimpleRoot_iff`, `mem_span_levelRaise_of_forall_heckeTCuspNat_eq_smul`, `mem_span_jointEigenspaceBasis`).

findings.evidence: Cocycle.lean:23 `namespace TauCeti` with no inner namespace; Free/Cocycle.lean:64 `namespace freeProP`; Free/RelatorFunctional.lean:127 `namespace freeProP`; naming-conventions doc: "The word 'of' is used to separate these hypotheses".
findings.fix: Open `namespace freeProP` in this file and rename to `freeProP.exists_locallyConstant_cocycle`, `freeProP.relationModule_le_span`, `freeProP.augmentation_apply_eq_zero_of_mem_proPFrattini`; update the two uses in `ProP/GolodShafarevich.lean` (lines 109, 123, 127).
findings.issue: The file's other three public declarations (`exists_locallyConstant_cocycle_of_freeProP` line 38, `relationModule_le_span` line 133, `augmentation_apply_eq_zero_of_mem_proPFrattini` line 181) also sit in bare `TauCeti`, while the adjacent free pro-`p` cocycle API lives in `TauCeti.freeProP` (`Free/Cocycle.lean:64` `namespace freeProP`: `exists_mem_Z1_forall_apply_of_eq`, `eq_of_mem_Z1_of_forall_of`, `Z1Equiv`; `Free/RelatorFunctional.lean:127` likewise). In addition `_of_freeProP` uses the `of` connective for the ambient type rather than a hypothesis, contrary to the convention that `of` separates hypotheses; the repo's precedent for a type suffix is `freeProP.isTopologicallyFinitelyGenerated_freeProP`-style juxtaposition, not `of`.

findings.evidence: GolodShafarevich.lean:69 `theorem card_sq_lt_four_mul_card (k : Type*) …` under `namespace TauCeti` with conclusion `Fintype.card ι ^ 2 < 4 * Fintype.card κ`; naming-conventions doc: "to disambiguate the name of theorem or better convey the intended reference, it is necessary to describe some of the hypotheses".
findings.fix: Add a hypothesis-describing suffix in Mathlib style, e.g. `card_sq_lt_four_mul_card_of_relations_le_span` (or `..._of_span_eq_ideal_of_forall_mem`), naming the relation hypothesis that fixes `ι` as the generators and `κ` as the relations.
findings.issue: `TauCeti.card_sq_lt_four_mul_card` is an unqualified root-namespace name whose two `card`s are not distinguished and whose subject (generators of a two-sided ideal and the span of their relations) is absent, so the name is both unsearchable and open to collision with any future card inequality.

summary: The recurrence, dimension-count and main pro-p names describe their conclusions correctly and the `IsPGroup` dot-notation placement is right, but the new `ProP/Relation/Cocycle.lean` puts its free pro-`p` cocycle API in bare `TauCeti` with names that do not identify their subject, breaking with the adjacent `TauCeti.freeProP` cocycle namespace.
